name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle built with motive power, a seat or saddle the rider sits astride, no more than three wheels, handlebar steering, and handlebar and foot controls, capable of more than 30 mph; an electric two-wheeler faster than a moped lands here whatever its wattage.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle the rider straddles, no more than three wheels, handlebar steering, and acceleration and braking by handlebar and foot controls
Capable of more than 30 mph; a slower one with an automatic transmission and a 50 cc or equivalent power unit is a moped
Riders need an operator's license authorizing motorcycles (Class M)
Riders and passengers under 18, and riders on an instruction permit, must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218
The operator must wear a face shield, glasses or goggles unless its windshield rises at least 15 inches above the handlebar
Handlebars may rise no more than 30 inches above the occupied seat, and it needs a mirror showing 200 feet behind
Carries a passenger only if the rider has a Class M license and it has a seat and footpegs for two
Lane splitting is illegal, though two motorcycles may share a lane if both riders agree
Titled and registered with the DMV for highway use; one used off the highways needs off-highway motorcycle registration with the DNR instead
